Tunisia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Tripoli, Libya.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of the Republic of Tunisia are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Tripoli, Libya.
Holders of diplomatic and service passports of the Republic of Tunisia are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days.
